purpose: Exact notes-cell substitutions for root integration; no CSV or intake was edited by the mapper.
matching_rule: Require the complete row identity and exact before_notes in canonical symbols.csv; corresponding preserved intake rows may retain earlier scope or first_use locators, so match their glyph, role and exact before_notes. Never apply a bare row-number replacement after rows have moved.
source_checks: List-Pettit AGG1.pdf, physical/printed pp.11,13,26-27: actual Greek capital Phi and indexed Phi_i denote collective and individual judgment sets.
def:p18-qev-normal-form: k=sum from i=1 to n of (m_i-1), with subtraction inside each summand.
sec:p15-measurement-impedance: actual reactance glyph X with roman subscript r.

repairs.before_notes: A_i is nonempty; superscript -i omits coordinate i.
Generic action arguments c_i and deviations d_i are separate from these maps.
repairs.after_notes: Generic action arguments \(c_i\) and deviations \(d_i\) are separate from these maps.

repairs.before_notes: Probability on S^{-i}; finite bridge separately uses predecessor T_i types.
repairs.after_notes: Probability on \(S^{-i}\); finite bridge separately uses predecessor \(T_i\) types.

repairs.before_notes: R_i is an own-type event; the literal R action in source Example 5.1 has its separately declared type.
repairs.after_notes: \(R_i\) is an own-type event; the literal \(R\) action in source Example 5.1 has its separately declared type.

repairs.before_notes: Local event bindings include F=CK[phi=varphi] and H=[a_i=c_i] intersect F; source action/type letters E H D are separately typed in their examples.
repairs.after_notes: Local event bindings include \(F=\mathrm{CK}[\phi=\varphi]\) and \(H=[a_i=c_i]\cap F\); source action/type letters \(E,H,D\) are separately typed in their examples.

repairs.role: finite-depth construction parameters and mass normalization
repairs.before_notes: Chain construction uses L=2m+5 and w_r=3^{L-r}; separate disagreement construction uses L=m+2 and weights 2^k. Each Z is its explicitly stated finite positive normalizer.
repairs.after_notes: Chain construction uses \(L=2m+5\) and \(w_r=3^{L-r}\); separate disagreement construction uses \(L=m+2\) and weights \(2^k\). Each \(Z\) is its explicitly stated finite positive normalizer.

repairs.role: preceding finite-model type and action sets
repairs.before_notes: Bridge identifies predecessor C_i with source action set A_i and constructs source S_i=A_i times T_i.
repairs.after_notes: Bridge identifies predecessor \(C_i\) with source action set \(A_i\) and constructs source \(S_i=A_i\times T_i\).

repairs.before_notes: w R_L v iff U_L(w) is contained in v; distinct from derivability.
repairs.after_notes: \(wR_Lv\) iff \(U_L(w)\) is contained in \(v\); distinct from derivability.

repairs.role: proposition agenda and the six-formula running agenda
repairs.before_notes: X need not be finite or deductively closed; X_0 consists of three opposing pairs.
repairs.after_notes: \(X\) need not be finite or deductively closed; \(X_0\) consists of three opposing pairs.

repairs.role: collective or individual sets of accepted agenda propositions
repairs.before_notes: These replace source Phi and Phi_i by explicitly defined local notation; nonmembership means nonassent.
repairs.after_notes: These replace source \(\Phi\) and \(\Phi_i\) by explicitly defined local notation; nonmembership means nonassent.

repairs.role: strict supermajority output and its agenda-relative closure
repairs.before_notes: H_k requires support strictly greater than (k-1)n/k; G_k can fail systematicity.
repairs.after_notes: \(H_k\) requires support strictly greater than \((k-1)n/k\); \(G_k\) can fail systematicity.

repairs.before_notes: k=sum of m_i minus one; count chosen equivalent CNFs rather than extra syntactic markers.
repairs.after_notes: \(k=\sum_{i=1}^{n}(m_i-1)\); count chosen equivalent CNFs rather than extra syntactic markers.

repairs.role: number of distinct variables in a finite decision input
repairs.before_notes: The 2^r bound counts assignments, not unit-time evaluations.
repairs.after_notes: The \(2^r\) bound counts assignments, not unit-time evaluations.

repairs.role: voltage current phase resistance reactance magnitude Jacobian and covariance of input mean
repairs.before_notes: Source reactance X is written X_r to distinguish it from the generic input vector; current converted to amperes.
repairs.after_notes: Source reactance \(X\) is written \(X_{\rm r}\) to distinguish it from the generic input vector; current converted to amperes.

repairs.role: integer lattice quantities in the complete split proof
repairs.before_notes: P=beta^p; B=beta^k; normalized positive integer X; rounded product BV. These are introduced together in this proof.
repairs.after_notes: \(P=\beta^p\); \(B=\beta^k\); normalized positive integer \(X\); rounded product \(BV\). These are introduced together in this proof.
